observations: The 402-aa query matches reviewed Vibrio CoaBC proteins at 60.1–62.0% identity and 91.8–99.3% query coverage; assignment is supported by homology.

CoaBC catalyzes two sequential CoA-biosynthesis steps: 4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate; then N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine → (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine + CO2.
